title: Contract Anatomy
description: Map the sections of a contract with neutral labels, visible scope, and a persistent information-only disclaimer.

defaultProps.title: Read the document in parts
defaultProps.subtitle: Separate scope, responsibilities, timing, and exit conditions before making a decision.

title: Case Timeline
description: Reveal a neutral chronology of notices, review points, and next decisions without asserting a legal outcome.

defaultProps.title: Make the sequence visible
defaultProps.subtitle: Use dated checkpoints to explain what happened and what still needs review.

title: Rights Flow
description: Present practical information and record-keeping steps as a clear visual flow, with neutral wording and no fabricated authority.

defaultProps.title: Know the next question
defaultProps.subtitle: Turn a rights-related explanation into four calm, reviewable information steps.

title: Terms Highlight
description: Cycle through important document terms while keeping the full document context in view.

defaultProps.title: Slow down at the key terms
defaultProps.subtitle: Highlight the words viewers should define before they compare or approve a document.

title: Policy Change
description: Compare a prior and updated policy structure while making the effective context and review prompt explicit.

defaultProps.title: Explain what changed
defaultProps.subtitle: Make a policy update easier to review without implying that one outcome applies everywhere.

title: Dispute Process
description: Show a configurable dispute or escalation sequence as checkpoints, not a promise of a particular legal remedy.

defaultProps.title: Show the process, not the guess
defaultProps.subtitle: Use explicit checkpoints to explain what someone may need to document and review next.

title: Privacy Consent
description: Explain purpose, choice, access, and retention as a neutral privacy-consent checkpoint with a clear review path.

defaultProps.title: Make the choice legible
defaultProps.subtitle: Describe why information is requested, what choice is available, and where the record lives.

title: Compliance Check
description: Check neutral documentation conditions one at a time and finish with a review status rather than a legal conclusion.

defaultProps.title: Review the record
defaultProps.subtitle: Turn a compliance conversation into a visible checklist of scope, ownership, retention, and dates.

title: Clause Compare
description: Place two neutral clause examples side by side so viewers can compare wording, context, and questions for review.

defaultProps.title: Compare the wording
defaultProps.subtitle: Show how two possible clauses differ in context without declaring which is appropriate.
defaultProps.leftClause: The first wording describes one possible scope and responsibility.
defaultProps.rightClause: The second wording describes another possible scope and responsibility.

title: Legal Glossary
description: Translate three document terms into plain-language definitions while keeping the source and context available for review.

defaultProps.title: Put the terms in plain language
defaultProps.subtitle: Give viewers a concise definition, then invite them to check the source document and context.

glossary.definition: A clear communication about a change or action.
A permission choice recorded with relevant context.
The period or condition described by the document.
